Meet your characters

Add a photo of each person and we'll draw them in costume for the book's opening page, free. Then paint two story pages with them, to see your family in the story. Every other page is painted from these characters after you order. No photo for a part? We'll use our own stand-in character for it, painted in the same style.

Photos that work best

  • A recent photo, in good daylight
  • Face to the camera, with the face nice and big (head and shoulders is ideal)
  • Eyes clearly visible: no sunglasses, hats pulled low or masks
  • Just them in the photo, or tell us who they are in a group photo
  • An ordinary phone photo is perfect

Try to avoid

  • Blurry, dark or very small photos
  • Faces far away, turned sideways or partly hidden
  • Heavy filters, stickers or edited faces
  • Photos of a screen or a printed photo

Your photos stay private. They're shrunk and stripped of hidden details (such as where they were taken) on your device, kept in encrypted storage in the EU, and never shown to anyone else. If you don't order, they're deleted after 14 days, or you can delete them now.
